clues.text: This family coaster tops out at a modest height of 39 feet, reaches speeds of 31 mph, and contains zero inversions.
Manufactured by Gerstlauer, this steel shuttle coaster welcomed its first riders in 2021.
This coaster operates in Australia, located within an iconic amusement park in Sydney, New South Wales.
This shuttle coaster is actually a mirror clone of Rewind Racers at Adventure City in Anaheim, California.
Fitting for a ride that travels forward and backward, it is named after the traditional Australian curved wooden tool that flies back to you when thrown.

evidence.quote: Boomerang is a steel shuttle roller coaster at Luna Park in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia.
Opened in 2021, it is a mirror clone of Rewind Racers at Adventure City in Anaheim, California, USA.
